heroHeadline: "Tarot" Crosses 1B Streams — Bad Bunny Holds Sole All-Time Spotify Record at 32 Songs; European Tour Opens in Barcelona in 5 Days
heroSubtitle: 'Tarot' (feat. Jhayco), the ambient bachata-infused closing meditation from Un Verano Sin Ti, has crossed 1 billion Spotify streams — becoming Bad Bunny's 32nd individual track to reach the milestone and surpassing The Weeknd's 31 to make Bad Bunny the sole all-time record holder for most billion-stream songs by any artist on the platform. The milestone came alongside 'Qué Pasaría…' (Rauw Alejandro feat. Bad Bunny) crossing 1B on the same day, raising his total count from 30 to 32 in a single 24-hour window. His billion-stream catalog now spans every era from early trap ('Soy Peor,' 'Krippy Kush') through YHLQMDLG ('Dakiti,' 'Yo Perreo Sola'), Un Verano Sin Ti ('Me Porto Bonito,' 'Tití Me Preguntó,' 'El Apagón,' 'Tarot'), and Debí Tirar Más Fotos ('DtMF,' 'EoO') — an unmatched depth across four studio album eras. The achievement lands five days before the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour opens its European stadium leg at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona (May 22–23, sold out) — Bad Bunny's first European stadium shows in six years. 'DtMF' remains at its 59th consecutive week at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs (chart dated May 16, 2026), continuing the all-time chart record. The Adidas Ballerina 'Flamboyan' (Vivid Red, KI7916, $120) — which dropped exclusively at All The Right NYC on May 15 — hits wide release via Adidas Confirmed on May 30. Director Residente's Deadline interview confirmed *Porto Rico* principal photography expected to begin late 2026 in Puerto Rico, with Bad Bunny leading as revolutionary José Maldonado Román alongside Viggo Mortensen, Edward Norton, and Javier Bardem.
